description: This source file defines the 'LogoutModel' class for handling user logout functionality in the ASP.NET Core Razor Pages application within the Identity area. It manages sign-out process, cache operations, and redirect logic.

classes.name: LogoutModel
classes.description: Handles the user logout process, including sign-out, cache management, logging, and redirecting users after logout.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the logout page; currently does nothing.

methods.name: OnPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to perform the logout sequence, clear authentication cookies, update cache, and redirect user.
